newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran shares jump 11 pct at day's end.
newsitem.headline: Ekran shares jump 11 pct at day's end.

text.p: Shares of Ekran Bhd the main developer of the giant Bakun hydroelectric dam, jumped 11 percent just ahead of the close on Monday on speculative buying, analysts and dealers said.
Ekran gained 55 cents to close at 5.55 ringgit with 11.66 million shares traded. It was the day's most actively traded issue and one of the highest gainers, with 11.7 million shares traded.
Analysts said they could see no fundamental reason for the stock's sudden rise, but said it may have been linked to the listing of the company's rights on Tuesday.

"There is a rumour that Ting (Pek Khiing, Ekran's chairman), may be looking to sell his stakes in PWE Industries and Granite to Ekran, and thereby increase his own stake in the company," said an Ekran analyst at a foreign brokerage house.
The company's one-for-one rights issue of 257.1 million shares was undersucbscribed by 62.77 percent last week.
Ting himself took up 150.98 million of the 161.42 million unsubscribed shares, which will cost him 859.8 million ringgit.
The rights issue was to fund Ekran's stake in the 15.5 billion ringgit Bakun Hydroelectric project, the biggest infrastructure development in Malaysia to date.
